thread_title: Find a post from the last 3 days: Why does coffee send me straight to the toilet? Is that normal?
thread_summary: Look for someone asking why coffee causes urgency, bloating or an upset stomach.
text: Very normal. Coffee gets the colon moving within minutes for a lot of people, and decaf does it for some too, so it isn't only the caffeine. A Copenhagen study this month also found regular coffee drinkers had a more diverse gut microbiome, though what that means for health is still open. If the urgency is a problem, try a smaller cup with food rather than on an empty stomach, and check whether milk makes it worse, since lactose is a common second culprit.
why: Recurring question, ties to this week's coffee and gut study, zero pitch.
